description: This file defines API endpoints related to dashboard templates, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and archiving templates. It uses FastAPI's routing and dependency injection features, interacts with a MongoDB database via motor, and references models and authentication functions.

classes.name: TemplateSummaryOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for summarizing dashboard templates in list responses.

methods.name: create_template( template: TemplateCreateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new dashboard template for the current user, ensuring the template ID is unique.

methods.name: list_templates( db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves all non-archived dashboard templates owned by the current user.

methods.name: get_template( template_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dashboard template by ID, only if owned by the current user.

methods.name: update_template( template_id: str, update: TemplateUpdateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing dashboard template owned by the current user.

methods.name: archive_template( template_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Soft-deletes (archives) a dashboard template owned by the current user.

ctags.name: archive_template
ctags.signature: ( template_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
